items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: I handed it over to Napoli Moore's brother, Jimmy

ctx.x: Would you play as long in a Jitney dance hall as you would at Burris? I mean, would the tune have as many choruses as well?

No, no, no. It was quite short. We'd play about three choruses in the dance hall, you know, and then stop. And there was a very funny thing that all the fellas around that time used to come in and sit in and practice. And one night I left, I took my instruments out and I handed it over to Napoli Moore's brother, Jimmy I believe he started. And by the time I went to the lake with the banjo player. And when we came back they were still playing for us so we put our instruments away and went home. And that happened…
